patch_description: This constructor combines square-grid defect seeds with a larger portfolio of asymmetric five-row triangular-layer seeds. The main new idea is a contact-graph portfolio: rather than relying on random perturbations of one grid, it deliberately changes row order, row margins, stagger phases, reflection, and vertical reversal to expose different wall-contact structures. Each seed is optimized with analytic nonlinear constraints, then polished from its certified solution. A strict common-scale certification guarantees containment and non-overlap independently of SLSQP termination tolerances.
